Interface LogProperty

All Known Subinterfaces:
LogProperty.Property<T>
@CaseChanging public sealed interface LogProperty permits LogProperty.Property<T>
Sealed marker interface implemented by LogProperty.Property, the reusable, key-based description of a configuration property that can be resolved against a LogProperties instance. Start with builder() (equivalently LogProperty.Property.builder()) to describe the key(s) a property should be looked up under and how its raw String value should be converted, and finish with LogProperty.Property.get(LogProperties) or LogProperty.Property.bind(LogProperties) to resolve it into a LogProperty.Result.
